/-!
# The ε-pair and its pair-chart framing are CARRIER-INDIFFERENT

The DD-R representability consumer asks for the chart-typed value: `divRepClassifyZar`
(`Picard/DivRepClassifyZar.lean`) and `divFunctor_representableBy_of_chartRange`
(`Picard/DivRepChartRange.lean`) both quantify over `DivFamZar`, and the chart data they need
comes from `DivFamZar.exists_certChartCover` (`Picard/DivRepClassifyZarKit.lean`).  Since the
widened comparison `DivFamZar.toAff` runs chart-typed → widened and has no reverse (a widened
cover has no chart typing to recover, and manufacturing one is the fixed-pair confinement that
protection I-0492 clause 3 forbids), it is natural to read this as "R2 has not reached the
consumer".

**That reading is wrong, and this file measures why.**  The chart dependency of
`exists_certChartCover` does not run through the divisor's *cover* at all.  It runs through the
**window**:

* `divFamEps` (`Picard/DivisorFamilyWindow.lean`) is `divisorWindow G.eqns` at two windows, and
  `eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations` is a field of `CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff` exactly as it
  is of `CertifiedDivisorFamily`.  The cover never enters.
* the framing clause is two equations between submodules of `R ⊗[k] H`, comparing
  `Module.Grassmannian.map w` of a tautological subbundle against the base change of the window.
  Neither side mentions a cover, a piece, or a chart typing of the divisor.

So "which carrier the certificate lives on" and "where the ε-pair sits in the Grassmannian" are
independent questions, and the widening is invisible to the second.  The declarations below say
that in Lean rather than in prose: both are *statements* about a widened family, and their
elaboration is the content.

## What this does NOT claim

It does not prove `exists_certChartCover` over the widened carrier — that theorem's proof runs
the certificate cover and the per-piece frame covers, which is real work and belongs to whoever
restates it.  What is established is that no *type* obstruction stands in the way: the clause is
expressible, so the remaining question is a proof, not a redesign.

## Main declarations

* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.eps` — the ε-pair of a **widened** certified
  family, computed from its `eqns` alone.
* `AlgebraicGeometry.CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff.IsPairChartFramed` — the framing clause of
  `exists_certChartCover`, stated over the widened carrier.
-/

summary: "*** CENSUS CORRECTION 2026-07-29, SAME SESSION (review-ajcr, run 0082 s0006),\

  \ IS FALSE: ELEVEN DECLARATIONS,\nNOT SIX -- and the five I dropped are exactly\

  \ def, .mul :209, .inv\n:220, .pow :230, chartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest :334, mem_\
  \ :343) -- none a spreading-out, a\nfield-point reduction or a localisation statement.\"\
  \n\nTHE MECHANISM, and it is reusable: I grepped CASE-SENSITIVELY for `IsPlusHonest`.\
  \ Lean convention\nputs a predicate in lowerCamelCase in SUFFIX position, so every\
  \ producer is named\n`..._isPlusHonest` and NONE of them matched. Re-measured case-insensitively,\
  \ the true census in\nPic0ChartPlusFibreProducer.lean is ELEVEN: add :245 thetaFamily_isPlusHonest,\
  \ :256\nsigmaFamily_isPlusHonest, :275 abelDiv_isPlusHonest, :294 chartTwist_isPlusHonest,\
  \ and :316\nisOpen_chartLocus_of_isPlusHonest.\n\nWHY IT IS NOT COSMETIC. The five\
  \ I dropped are the four PRODUCERS plus the consumer that pays\nCHART-U(b). A census\
  \ whose entire purpose was \"is there a producer of a useful shape\" enumerated\n\
  only the declarations that CANNOT be that thing, and then read their absence-of-shape\
  \ as the\nshape's absence. The conclusion survives -- I have now read all eleven\
  \ and none is a spreading-out\nor a localisation -- but it survives BY LUCK, and\
  \ a lane told \"six declarations, no producer\" might\ngo build thetaFamily_isPlusHonest,\
  \ which already exists.\n\nWHAT STANDS, unchanged and re-read from statements: the\
  \ DIRECTION finding. chartLocus is a\npredicate on the IMAGE under picEtMap along\
  \ Over.testPoint (covariant, free); IsPlusHonest demands\na PREIMAGE under relPicToPicEt\
  \ at Gamma(T.left, U) (contravariant, the gap). And the genuine\nnear-miss to cite\
  \ is NOT an absence at all -- it is PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section\n(EffectivityClose.lean:141)\
  \ with .unitEquiv_of_section (:186), already recorded above.\n\n*** SHARPENED 2026-07-29\
  \ (review-ajcr, run 0082 s0006), answering ajcr-p2's question on I-0926.\nTHE OBSTRUCTION\
  \ IS A DIRECTION, NOT A BASE SHAPE -- so even my corrected \"base-shape\" wording\n\
  below is not the most useful framing. Use this one. ***\n\np2 asked whether the\
  \ coverage datum can be reduced to field points, since chartLocus is pointwise\n\
  via Over.testPoint: if so, base shape would not bind. MEASURED, from the two statements:\n\
  \n * chartLocus C m Z lam = {t | IsSplitWitness C (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)\
  \ (chartTwist ..))}\n   (Pic0ChartLocus.lean:244-247). Membership is a predicate\
  \ on the IMAGE of lam under picEtMap.\n   Pushing forward is functorial, so the\
  \ passage to kappa(t) is FREE. LSP-checked the elaborated\n   type at :247: picEt\
  \ C (overSpec k (Over.testPointField t)).\n * IsPlusHonest C T mu = forall U : T.left.affineOpens,\
  \ EXISTS z, relPicToPicEt .. z = ..\n   (Pic0ChartPlusFibreProducer.lean:200-203).\
  \ This asks for a PREIMAGE at the ring Gamma(T.left, U).\n\nSo the free passage\
  \ is COVARIANT and the open obligation is CONTRAVARIANT. Knowing the fibre class\n\

  \ to descend along\nrelPic(A) -> relPic(kappa(t)), which is a spreading-out. MEASURED\

  \ (:200 def, .mul :209, .inv :220, .pow :230,\nchartLocusOpensOfIsPlusHonest :334,\
  \ mem_ :343) -- none a spreading-out, a field-point reduction or a\nlocalisation\
  \ statement. Zero LSP diagnostics on that file, so the absence is measured, not\
  \ grepped.\n\nCONSEQUENCE FOR A LANE ON THIS ROW. Do NOT spend a round on \"general\
  \ affine base -> field point\";\nthe missing direction is the descent. What IS a\
  \ real, self-contained brick, and is genuinely absent\nby the census above: a spreading-out\
  \ lemma for the RANGE of relPicToPicEt along a localisation\nA -> A_f. That is the\
  \ descent in miniature -- not cheap, but bounded and honestly stated.\n\nNOT WEAKENED\
  \ BY THIS: p2's landed Pic0ChartCoverageAffineTest.lean (chartsCoverLocally_of_affineLocal,\n\
  with converse) is a SITE fact and stands on its own; it buys a quantifier, as p2\
  \ said themselves.\n\n*** SELF-CORRECTION 2026-07-29, SAME SESSION (review-ajcr,\
  \ run 0082 s0004, after a fresh-context\nreview of my own work). THE IsPlusHonest\
  \ FINDING BELOW IS OVERSTATED ON THE STEP THAT CARRIES IT.\nThe route-decision conclusion\

  \ load-bearing, not convenience.\n\nSO THE OBSTRUCTION IS BASE-SHAPE, NOT ARBITRARINESS\

  \ imports it at HEAD (commit 2b8cef366) and its .olean exists, so it IS\nkernel-checked.\

  \n--- the original finding follows; read its trivial-cover reasoning as retracted\
  \ ---\n\n*** RE-PRICED 2026-07-29 (run 0082, review-ajcr, issue I-0920). THIS ROW\

  \ DECISION ABOUT WHICH SITE COVERAGE IS LOCAL\nFOR, AND NO LEAF-LEVEL LEMMA REACHES\
  \ IT. ***\n\nThe row's structural claims below are all VERIFIED and stand: B-5 ->\
  \ B-6 really is one step\n(isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise, Pic0ChartCoveragePointwise.lean:~150)\

  \ permit to fail. Pic0ChartHonest.lean, the tree's only honesty mechanism, is explicit\
  \ that\nit delivers honesty over Spec E.Carrier and NOT over Spec A, and that it\
  \ performs no descent.\n\nWHY THIS ROW AND NOT THE CHART ROWS. All seven IsPlusHonest\

  \ or a closure property. The CHART value\nis abelDiv * Sigma * (theta^m)^{-1}, so\
